verdict.rationale: Browserbase is a browser-automation and scraping platform, so honouring robots.txt and per-site rate limits is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any robots.txt compliance setting or automatic target-site rate limiting. Concurrency at scale, CAPTCHA handling and scheduling are related features but do not deliver this capability.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can configure the crawler to respect robots.txt rules and target-site rate limits automatically
